pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Projectile-tagged damage makes the guard teleport and reject the hit. It can block and has brief protected attack segments. Otherwise accepted damage is multiplied by 75% before later defenses. Bait movement, then retaliate after the block.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Enderitium Gem. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
